pairs.equivalence_rationale: Both functions bind label once and return the same span tree.
assumptions: The function is invoked once per render.

tsrx.source: export function View(): unknown @{ const label = "ready"; {label} }

tsx.source: export function View(): unknown { const label = "ready"; return {label}; }

pairs.equivalence_rationale: Both arrows bind label once and return the same span tree.
assumptions: The arrow is invoked once per render.

tsrx.source: export const View = (): unknown => @{ const label = "ready"; {label} };

tsx.source: export const View = (): unknown => { const label = "ready"; return {label}; };

pairs.equivalence_rationale: The TSRX branches and TSX conditional select identical span trees.

tsrx.source: declare const ready: boolean; export const view = @if (ready) { yes } @else { no };

tsx.source: declare const ready: boolean; export const view = ready ? yes : no;

pairs.equivalence_rationale: Both forms render one span containing each item in source order.
assumptions: items is a finite string array.
No key, index, or empty clause is used.

tsrx.source: declare const items: string[]; export const view = @for (const item of items) { {item} };

tsx.source: declare const items: string[]; export const view = items.map((item) => {item});

pairs.equivalence_rationale: Both forms select the same span for ready and the same fallback otherwise.
assumptions: status is either ready or fallback.

tsrx.source: declare const status: "ready" | "fallback"; export const view = @switch (status) { @case "ready": { ready } @default: { fallback } };

tsx.source: declare const status: "ready" | "fallback"; export const view = (() => { switch (status) { case "ready": return ready; default: return fallback; } })();

pairs.equivalence_rationale: The TSRX expression name and TSX capitalized alias resolve to the same tag binding.
assumptions: as names an intrinsic element accepted by the renderer.

tsrx.source:
declare const as: "section" | "article";
export const view = <{as} className="panel">content</{as}>;

exclusions.no_faithful_tsx_reason: A counted TSRX render loop has statement-loop control flow rather than one canonical TSX render expression.
TSX has no syntax that couples an iteration result with an empty fallback without additional control machinery.
The TSRX index clause carries framework iteration semantics that a plain TSX expression does not specify.
The key clause is renderer metadata and has no parser-only TSX equivalent with identical intent.

exclusions.construct: statements inside a JSX child code block
exclusions.no_faithful_tsx_reason: TSX children cannot directly contain declarations and statements without adding an execution wrapper.
Raw CSS tokenization inside style is TSRX syntax and is not a JavaScript expression child.
TypeScript module specifiers must be strings and cannot preserve the identifier submodule relation.

exclusions.construct: @try with pending or catch render branches
exclusions.no_faithful_tsx_reason: TSX has no expression syntax for the pending and error render lifecycle without framework-specific helpers.
